title: The Funniest Pup
lines: Six pups sat in a big box.
The tan pup hid in a red hat.
It was the funniest pup of all.
Meg tried to lift it out.
The pup cried and did not come out.
Then Sam held up a bit of meat.
Out it came! It was the happiest pup.

questions.ask: Where did the tan pup hide?
questions.listenFor: In a red hat. Second line. Have them point at it.

questions.ask: What got the pup to come out?
questions.listenFor: A bit of meat that Sam held up. Listen for the meat, not just for Sam.

questions.ask: Do you think that pup was really the funniest? Why?
questions.listenFor: Either answer. What you want is a reason - hiding in a hat is the one in the story.
